Nimbus Labs makes scheduling software for clinics. We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead our React and Next.js web app and the design system behind it.

What you will do
- Build accessible React and Next.js interfaces in TypeScript.
- Own shared components, Storybook and design tokens used by several teams.
- Work with our Node.js and PostgreSQL backend team on APIs.

Requirements
- 5+ years of React and TypeScript in production.
- Next.js and server-side rendering.
- Accessibility: WCAG, keyboard navigation and screen readers.
- Tailwind or another CSS architecture at scale.
- React Native is a plus.

Location: remote, worldwide. English is our working language.
